reviews.subfamily: Collected Northern HA fiscal chronic-disease rates
reviews.summary: Recovered and released 480 original Northern HA fiscal observations: four age-standardized incidence indicators and four lifetime-prevalence indicators, each for Total/Female/Male across 20 fiscal periods. Source rates remain direct original values per 1,000; they are not recomputed from population.
reviews.mapConnection: An optional exact HA ID 5 join uses the contemporary PGMaps Northern HA polygon as context. Historical boundary compatibility is unverified. Default display remains the trend chart. One indicator, source sex category and fiscal period is required for one map value; overlapping rows are withheld rather than summed. The visible map place is Northern HA, while the internal entity remains the exact indicator.
needs: Actual CHSA scientific observations; the 309-row locations catalogue does not supply CHSA measurements.
Historical HA boundary documentation before claiming spatial harmonization across FY2001–2002 to FY2020–2021.
The standardization population, confidence intervals and detailed registry ascertainment notes for stronger cross-indicator comparisons.
cannot: Spread Northern HA rates into CHSAs, LHAs, census units, cities or facilities.
Infer disease counts by multiplying age-standardized rates by Atlas population estimates or projections.
Treat lifetime prevalence as incidence or add sex/condition rates.
Treat an April 2026 collection as a current health observation.
Join older calendar-year series with different age ranges or units merely because indicator names resemble each other.
Infer trial eligibility, unmet need, causality or an NHHR effect from these aggregate registry observations.

reviews.mapConnection: The seven exact existing comparator labels join reviewed representative institution points. Values describe institution totals and are not allocated to the mapped campus, surrounding city or health region. NOSM and BC Cancer have no emitted enrolment row.

A population denominator matching the enrolment universe, geography and reference period; enrolment is not a count of local resident students.

Use UBC all-campus totals as Vancouver-campus enrolment.
Use the Thunder Bay composite 9,035 as a Lakehead-only total; the independently verified Lakehead total is 8,499.
Assign approximate NOSM contributions or absent institutions a zero.
Treat institutional enrolment as FTEs, graduates, health workforce or available NHHR researchers.
